finding.claim: Streamable HTTP server performs no Origin/Host validation, so a DNS-rebinding page can reach unauthenticated tools on a local or unauthenticated endpoint (MCP 2025-11-25 MUST not met). Conditional on deployment.
finding.source: Attacker-controlled web page that rebinds its hostname to 127.0.0.1; initialize needs no session, so the attacker obtains Mcp-Session-Id from the response.
finding.guards_checked: Accept (streamable_http_transport.rb:528), Content-Type (:547), session-ID presence (:393) and existence (:719), MCP-Protocol-Version (:585). No check of Origin or Host; grep for Origin|HTTP_HOST in lib/ returns no matches. Cross-origin non-rebinding POSTs are blocked by CORS because there is no OPTIONS handler (returns 405), so the exposure is specifically DNS rebinding.

finding.claim: Notifications bypass session validation: a notification with an unknown Mcp-Session-Id is accepted with 202 and dispatched to the shared Server with no session, invoking user notification handlers.
finding.source: Any POST with a notification body (no id) and an arbitrary or nonexistent Mcp-Session-Id header.
finding.sink: @server.handle_json with session nil -> user handlers (roots_list_changed_handler, define_custom_method for notifications/*).

trace.note: server_session stays nil when @sessions[session_id] is missing
handle -> handle_request runs the user notification handler

finding.guards_checked: Only the missing-session-ID check (streamable_http_transport.rb:393). The response path (:416) and request path (:719) both verify the session exists; the notification path does not.

finding.claim: A JSON-RPC batch containing a non-object element (e.g. [1] or ["x"]) raises an uncaught TypeError that terminates the stdio server loop instead of returning a per-element -32600 response (JSON-RPC 2.0 section 6). Not executed; established by reading.
finding.source: A stdin line containing a batch with a non-object element, sent by the connected stdio client.
finding.sink: Server loop termination in StdioTransport#open (the process stops reading requests).

trace.note: request[:id] on Integer/String raises TypeError; line is outside the begin block at line 104
open rescues only Interrupt, so the exception propagates and the loop ends

finding.guards_checked: Empty-array check only (json_rpc_handler.rb:30). StreamableHTTP transport rejects non-object bodies (streamable_http_transport.rb:385), so this affects stdio and direct Server#handle_json callers only.

finding.claim: Client-credentials grant against a legacy server with no PRM and no challenge scope raises NoMethodError: resolve_scope dereferences a nil prm, and the provider's configured scope is never consulted. Availability and logic bug only; no auth bypass.
finding.source: Server that returns no Protected Resource Metadata and a 401 WWW-Authenticate challenge without a scope parameter; provider.authorization_flow == :client_credentials.
finding.sink: prm["scopes_supported"] in resolve_scope raises NoMethodError on nil.

trace.note: run! dispatches to run_client_credentials! when the provider uses the client_credentials flow
locate_authorization_server returns [nil, base] when PRM fetch fails
run_client_credentials! calls resolve_scope(scope: scope, prm: prm) with prm nil
NoMethodError escapes from the Faraday::UnauthorizedError rescue clause unwrapped

finding.guards_checked: Auth-code path guards this with prm || {} (flow.rb:62); the client-credentials path does not. Early return at flow.rb:558 applies only when a challenge scope is present; provider scope (flow.rb:563) is unreachable here.
